Screen geometry, the same in every shot at the pond: seen from the side, the frog's own bank is on the left, the water lies across the middle, and the far bank with the yard, the leaning fence and the coop is on the right. The pair are on the coop's own bank with no water between them and it, and they are leaving it behind, so they cross the picture from right to left - the reverse of the frog's way there.

[Shot 1] A medium shot. The camera tracks beside them at their own height at fast speed. The hen runs flat out along the bank with the frog up on her back beside her neck, and the dust she throws up hangs behind them and thins away.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, the shot cuts to: a close-up low at the ground, the camera static, the track running across the frame. She comes past at speed and is gone out of the picture in a moment, and the dust closes over the empty track behind her.

[Shot 3] At 00:04.500, the shot cuts to: a medium close-up from the front, travelling with them. The two of them are looking at each other rather than at where they are going, and neither of them looks forward once.

[Shot 4] At 00:06.500, the shot cuts to: an extreme close-up of his hands in her feathers. He rides the stride, rocking with it, and takes a firmer hold of her feathers without looking down.

[Shot 5] At 00:08.500, the shot cuts to: a wide shot from behind them, the camera static. They carry on away from us along the bank, getting smaller, and the dust hangs in the air where they have been.

overall_soundscape
A working summer farm, quiet and constant under everything: wet plops, crickets,
the low mutter of hens off frame, corrugated tin ticking in the heat, one distant
tractor that never arrives. Flies. No cartoon sound effects of any kind - no
boings, no slide whistles, no comedy impacts. Any croak or cluck is
recorded-real, never performed.

non_diegetic_music
No music of any kind. No song, no score, no stings, no risers, no instruments.
No singing and no voice: nobody speaks and nobody sings, and no character's
mouth forms words. Ambient sound only.
